'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a NPC male Royan Shepherd who can be found next to a Giant [[Soliskin]] in [[Soliseed Plains]]. He asks Rover for help in locating and guiding the wandering Soliskin back to Bjartr Woods.<ref>[[Monument of Returning Soliseeds]]</ref>

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(First time dialogue)
:'''Lyosroth:''' Hello, {{Rover}}. Forgive me for being so blunt, but there's something I was hoping you could help us with.
:'''Lyosroth:''' The bulk of the Shepherds at Bjartr Woods are engaged in tasks lately, with each having to look after over twenty Soliskins.
:'''Lyosroth:''' And over a hundred Soliskin descended from the Solvein Canopy again just yesterday alone...
:'''Lyosroth:''' With so few Shepherds, many Soliskin are now wandering aimlessly around Lahai-Roi... And of course, there are those that simply ran off to who knows where.
:'''Lyosroth:''' We would search for them ourselves, but we can't afford to leave the ones under our care...
:'''Lyosroth:''' If it's not too much to ask, could you help us find the missing Soliskin?
:{{DIcon}} Hide-and-seek. My favorite game!
:{{DIcon}} Do I get paid?
::'''Lyosroth:''' Of course.
:{{DIcon}} Glad to help.
:'''Lyosroth:''' You may find me with the Giant Soliskin at the heart of Soliseed Plains once you've retrieved a Soliskin.
:'''Lyosroth:''' Our rewards await. We're counting you, {{Rover}}.
----
;(First time delivering Soliseeds)
:'''Giant Soliskin:''' Luu? Luu-Luu! (*Excited cheeps*)
:'''Lyosroth:''' A Soliskin has just returned to us, {{Rover}}! Was it your doing?
:'''Lyosroth:''' It's astonishing how you managed to find this lost Soliskin so quickly! Wait, what's that in your hand?
:'''Lyosroth:''' It's a Soliseed of Essehalo! Did you receive this from the lost Soliskin, {{Rover}}?
:'''Lyosroth:''' Soliskin produce Soliseeds from their Essehalos, and treat them as their own offspring.
:'''Lyosroth:''' They only give them to people they trust. It seems seeking your help was the right decision, {{Rover}}!
:'''Giant Soliskin:''' Chuu, luuluu! (*Excited cheeps*)
:'''Lyosroth:''' The Giant Soliskin shows its thanks and would like you to accept this gift.
:'''Lyosroth:''' Please, take it. We will have more gifts waiting for you if you manage to find more Soliskin and Soliseeds!
{{Dialogue End}}
